qa.method: Manual factual grading against predeclared expected answers. Incomplete, incorrect, and abstained answers score zero. Literal quotation checks are a separate diagnostic; quotes were not repaired and requests were not retried.

artifact_contents: Aggregate metrics, predeclared cases, source hashes, scoring usage/timings, target-file scores and full-score hashes, output hashes and retained facts, manually reviewed QA answers. Full snapshots, scores, literal quotes, raw responses and harness remain in local_receipts.
